comments.body: Provider test-mode path works; exercising the sandbox processor next.

content.text: Provider test-mode path works; exercising the sandbox processor next.
Storing a payment method today still routes through the change-plan checkout sheet, which scares teams who only want a backup instrument on file before renewal.

Split the flow: “Add payment method” stores the instrument via the billing provider setup intent without changing plan_id or triggering proration. Plan changes stay on a separate “Change plan” path that can reuse the default method.

Acceptance: users with a method and no plan change see no invoice preview; failed setup intents do not leave orphan customer objects; the settings page shows methods with a default star independent of plan tier.
